On the 046accf6 current run rd_kafka_sasl_safe_string (rdkafka_sasl_scram.c:243 `d = safe = rd_malloc(len + 1)`, :249 `return safe`) is still a provisional Unsafe leak resting on this precision loss, the only finding of unit rdkafka_sasl_scram.c (which also carries `loop re-acquisition` at :243). ledger.title: A leak whose acquisition site carries `loop re-acquisition` is accused across a loop's generation join
ledger.text: Registered by CURRENT-UNSAFE-TRIAGE as an implementation card (USER DECISION 2026-11-07, verbatim: "Register four as implementation cards"). rd_kafka_snappy_java_uncompress (snappy.c) holds 7 provisional Unsafe leaks of `outbuf = rd_malloc(uof)` (:1705), reported at :1648, :1660, :1680, :1694, :1701, :1712 and :1721; the function also carries `loop re-acquisition` at :1705. :1648, :1660 and :1701 are pass-2 re-checks of bytes pass 1 accepted (W44-LEAK-PIN-AUDIT rows 223-225, PATH-INSENSITIVE-SCALAR-CORRELATION); :1680 and :1694 return after rd_free(outbuf) and :1721 returns outbuf (inferred: the pass loop's generation join). DISCHARGE: run the QCORE_LEAK_WITNESS census on the function first to confirm the attribution; then a Leak is not validated where its witness joins generations of an acquisition the same function reports as re-acquired in a loop (the site is reported under its refusal instead), with fixtures for a true leak inside such a loop that still validates, Lean parity, and a measurement showing snappy.c leave Unsafe without any Safe move from this rule alone.

ledger.title: A NULL test inside __builtin_expect / unlikely() does not refine the tested acquisition
ledger.text: Registered by CURRENT-UNSAFE-TRIAGE as an implementation card (USER DECISION 2026-11-07, verbatim: "Register four as implementation cards"). snappy.c:1712 reports a leak of `outbuf` on the `if (unlikely(!outbuf))` arm, where the allocation failed and nothing is held (W44-LEAK-PIN-AUDIT row 226). DISCHARGE: read `__builtin_expect(e, c)` as `e` for branch refinement (its value is e; c is a hint only), so the failure arm refines the site away; fixtures for likely()/unlikely() around null and non-null tests and for a __builtin_expect whose operand is not a bare test (stays refused); Lean parity; measured.

ledger.title: An acquisition call result stored through a refused destination is accused as a leak
ledger.text: Registered by CURRENT-UNSAFE-TRIAGE as an implementation card (USER DECISION 2026-11-07, verbatim: "Register four as implementation cards"). cmt_map_metric_get (cmt_map.c) is provisional Unsafe on a leak of `calloc` at :210 stored into `metric->hist_buckets` (a field of an object reached through a parameter; metric_release_storage frees it later), while metric_prepare_storage itself is Unknown with `indirect memory access is outside the resource projection` at :210. Hypothesis, not yet census-confirmed: the result is never bound to a name, so the refused hand-on rule has nothing to withdraw (same family as unpack_basic_type in W44-ASSIGNMENT-DESTINATION-SUFFIX-PLACE). DISCHARGE: confirm with the QCORE_LEAK_WITNESS census; then a store whose destination is refused and whose value is an acquisition result marks the site escaped-unresolved (as the refused hand-on rule does for bound places), fail-closed to Unknown; fixtures; Lean parity; measured with cmt_map.c leaving Unsafe and no Safe move from this rule alone.
